findings.statement: Independent reconstruction of all 20 frozen attempts yields 13 eligible primary items, balanced cases CASE-001 and CASE-006, repeat depth 1, 5 recovery-affected, 7 failed, 2 superseded, and 0 NOT_RUN attempts. Against frozen minima 4 and 2, the correct result remains INSUFFICIENT with semantic judges skipped and ranking prohibited; all recovery records are GAP_EVIDENCE_ONLY and ranking-ineligible.
findings.pass_condition: Fresh projection reproduces all counts and recovery evidence never enters comparative ranking.

findings.statement: All 20 evidence IDs and arm/case/run identities are unique. Every eligible row has an arm-attributed task_input_hash, each case has exactly one eligible hash, and no eligible hash is missing or mismatched; missing or conflicting hashes fail consistency and cannot support a balanced case.
findings.pass_condition: Missing or conflicting eligible task hashes prohibit ranking and duplicate identities are rejected before counting.

findings.statement: The pre-adjudication record explicitly contains and passes exactly license, answer_contamination, security, second_state_source, second_orchestrator, and scope_conflict. The builder requires nonempty, unique candidate coverage exactly equal to configured targets before any comparative gate can pass.
findings.pass_condition: All six gates remain explicit and incomplete, missing, or duplicate candidate coverage fails closed.

findings.statement: Canonical bundle, freeze, evidence-items, sufficiency-record, and pre-adjudication-record hashes reproduce; all 20 allowed raw-run hashes match the freeze. Decision timestamps derive from resolved policy frozen_at rather than the config and consistently equal 2026-09-01T11:57:13+08:00.
findings.pass_condition: All bindings reproduce and every decision timestamp equals the resolved policy frozen_at value.

findings.target: Replay implementation exposure and evidence invariance
findings.statement: The allowed bundle now exposes the final-replay implementation and the freeze binds its current file hash. Hardening changes governing hashes but leaves the evidence-items hash, reconstructed counts, six hard-gate result, and EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT non-ranking conclusion unchanged.
findings.pass_condition: Every first-round bundle exposes the replay source, its hash matches the freeze, and evidence conclusions remain invariant.

findings.statement: decision_sets_equal rejects empty sets, missing members, content differences, absent IDs, empty IDs, and non-string IDs. build_replay includes this result in rebuild_checks and raises DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY_UNSTABLE whenever the comparator or any other rebuild check fails.
findings.pass_condition: Empty, incomplete, content-different, or invalid-ID decision sets make replay unstable and fail closed.

findings.statement: The comparator builds nonempty decision_id-keyed maps and compares the complete maps, so equivalent decision sets pass regardless of file order while differing content does not.
findings.pass_condition: Permuting decision-file order preserves equality only when the full ID-keyed decision content is equal.

findings.statement: The comparator returns failure immediately when either side repeats a decision_id, preventing dictionary overwrite from concealing duplicate or conflicting decisions; replay then fails stability and raises.
findings.pass_condition: Any duplicate decision ID on either side deterministically fails final replay before an accepted stable result.
